Application Data.NAME: ClearView Blinds & Shades
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ClearView Blinds & Shades specializes in the retail and installation of a wide range of window treatments, including custom blinds, shades, and curtains. Our services cater to both residential and commercial clients, ensuring high-quality products that enhance aesthetic appeal and energy efficiency. We prioritize the use of non-toxic materials and adhere to all safety regulations, specifically avoiding any installation of lead-containing window treatments, particularly in older buildings. Our dedicated team focuses on providing exceptional customer service and expertise in helping clients select the perfect window solutions for their spaces. We also offer consultation services to assist clients in design and functionality considerations tailored to their unique needs.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• A business without a fixed location experiences repeated claims for damaged goods during
transit and installation, leading to non-renewal due to unacceptable risk exposure.
Unique Industry-Related Restriction
• Prohibition on Installation of Lead-Containing Window Treatments: Due to in-
creasing regulatory scrutiny and health concerns, insurers restrict coverage for businesses
installing window treatments containing lead-based paints or components. This restriction
is particularly relevant for firms servicing older buildings or historic properties where such
materials may still be present. The rationale is to avoid liability and cleanup costs associated
with lead exposure, which can result in significant environmental and bodily injury claims.
